articles.summary: PITTSBURGH, May 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- L.B. Foster Company (NASDAQ: FSTR), a global technology solutions provider of products and services for the Rail and Infrastructure markets, announced today that, effective June 1, 2026, its Board of Directors has promoted certain executive officers.
articles.title: L.B. Foster Company Announces the Appointment of Executive Officers

articles.summary: First quarter net sales totaled $121.1 million, up 23.9% over last year; Rail segment sales growth was exceptionally strong improving 38.4%, while Infrastructure sales were also favorable up 5.9%. First quarter net income of $1.5 million was up $3.6 million over last year; EBITDA 1 of $5.2
articles.title: L.B. Foster Company Announces Strong Sales Growth and Profitability Expansion in 2026 First Quarter; Reaffirms Full Year 2026 Financial Guidance
